task.title: Deprecate frontmatter code-path links
task.summary: Migrate knowledge metadata, graph linking, lint, audits, and KB frontmatter so routine doc-code links are generated by graph inputs instead of maintained as code_paths in knowledge frontmatter.

goal.outcome: Knowledge docs no longer require routine frontmatter code_paths; graph-derived doc-code relationships remain available and stale explicit overrides stay audited.
acceptance: Doc parser and graph treat frontmatter code_paths as optional explicit overrides, not required routine mapping truth.
Lint no longer reports knowledge docs as unscoped solely because code_paths/spec_paths are absent when diagram refs or graph-derived mappings exist.
Graph derives doc-code relationships from file-structure/diagram mappings, roadmap tasks, builds, validation evidence, source facts, and explicit refs.
Existing KB frontmatter is migrated or marked so routine exact code_paths are removed without creating stale-reference or unscoped-doc drift.
TASK-specific guard proves stale frontmatter code_paths no longer drive routine doc-code linking.
non_goals: Do not remove roadmap task code_paths, implementation build code_files, validation proof refs, or explicit override code_paths that are intentionally precise.
Do not change graph JSON schema except for additive derived-link metadata if needed.
